chunks: Has he peeped into the Unknown, or obtained a promise from Ar-Rahman?

key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنِ: The Merciful, one of the primary names of God
key_terms.الْغَيْبَ: The Unseen or hidden realm known only to God

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to have peeped into the Unseen or made a promise with God?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Maryam, this verse serves as a rhetorical challenge to the polytheists of Mecca who claimed divine sonship or exclusive access to heavenly secrets. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi, highlight that it refutes the notion of any created being possessing independent knowledge of the Unseen (al-Ghayb) or holding a binding covenant with Allah apart from the Prophets and Imams.
